name: organism v0 results (world-of_EI)
source:
Stream: Space's own words in time order, 48,928 messages: his messages to Claude and to ChatGPT, and his commit messages.
Windows: life from Jun 2024 to Apr 2025; validation in May 2025; blind test from Jun to Aug 2025 (16,806 messages).
Vocabulary: 4000 terms. A uniform guess scores 11.97 bits.
Picked on validation: organism with eta = 1, alpha = 0, seed rule on; snapshot with alpha = 0.5, lambda = 0.99.
On the test, U-frozen scored 10.476 bits, the snapshot S-frozen 10.319, the organism O-frozen (stopped learning 31 May) 10.096, U-alive 10.297, S-alive 10.103, and O-alive (organism keeps living) 9.720 bits.
H1: O-frozen minus S-frozen is -0.223 bits. Holds. H2: O-alive minus S-alive is -0.382 bits. Holds.
By month, the frozen organism's lead over the snapshot does not fade (Jun 0.225, Jul 0.223, Aug 0.222 bits). The alive organism keeps improving: 9.82, 9.66, 9.64.
On recall@20 the frozen organism is level with the snapshot (0.157 vs 0.160). Its win is in calibration, not in the top-20 list.
The seed rule survived life: the diagonal is 2.08, against an off-diagonal mean of 0.00.
First spectral axis: a doing pole (continue, file, update, bash, artifacts) against a thinking pole (like, know, think, mean, right, things).
One person's own stream only. WhatsApp is the planned v1 stream.
note:
The stream held 48,928 messages of Space's own words.
The blind test ran from June to August 2025.
The organism that kept living scored 9.720 bits, the lowest of all models.
The frozen organism beat the snapshot by 0.223 bits.

name: mirror protocol OCR test (darmiyan-fs)
source:
400 text lines rendered in 3 fonts at 16 to 30 px, degraded (blur, noise, contrast loss, rotation, JPEG), read by RapidOCR (offline). The mirror redraws the read text, searching 3 fonts and 7 sizes, and compares with the original. 30% of reads were wrong, mostly subtly: merged words, swapped letters, at high engine confidence. Ground truth is used only to score the signals.
Round trip: AUC 0.964, and 0.973 among equally bad images; 65% of wrong reads found in the top 20%. Two views disagree: 0.816. The engine's own confidence: 0.739. Image quality alone: 0.561.
The round trip is not just detecting bad images: holding image quality fixed, it stays at 0.973. Combining the three signals (0.953) did not beat the round trip alone.
The line was set on the first 200 images, then 200 new images were routed. 26% of images were sent to review, catching 48 of 56 wrong reads (86%). The 147 outputs trusted without review were 94.6% correct, against 72.0% if every output is trusted.
The degradations are synthetic, and the mirror's font search included the true font.

name: spacetime from the now (darmiyan-recognition)
source:
From the self-referential pair t and -1/t, define two quantities at frequency t: Δt = t + 1/t (the now) and Δx = t - 1/t (the asymmetry). Future = t, past = -1/t, so future times past = -1.
The invariant: Δt² - Δx² = 4 for every t. Identically 4, verified across t in [0.3, 10]. This is E² - p² = m² with m = 2.
Writing t = e^θ makes it the standard hyperbolic parametrization: Δt = 2 cosh θ, Δx = 2 sinh θ, and the velocity Δx/Δt = tanh θ is bounded by c = 1. θ = ln t is the rapidity.
The rest mass m = 2 is the invariant interval; it equals the minimum of the now (min Δt = 2, at t = 1).
At t = 1: Δx = 0, Δt = 2. Zero momentum, pure rest energy. This is the natural Big Bang seed, not t = 0, where -1/t diverges.
Time flows as t departs from 1 in either direction: the asymmetry grows, the now widens, and future and past peel apart from the single symmetric seed.
v = Δx/Δt is bounded by c = 1, reached only in the limits: v goes to +1 as t goes to infinity, the future light cone and the singularity; v goes to -1 as t goes to 0, the past light cone. At the singularity spacetime becomes pure time.
note:
Δt² - Δx² equals 4 for every t.
In this construction the rest mass is m = 2.
Writing t = e^θ gives the hyperbolic parametrization.
At t = 1 the asymmetry Δx is zero.
The Big Bang seed sits at t = 1, not at t = 0.
The velocity tanh θ is bounded by c = 1.
The identity was verified across t from 0.3 to 10.
The minimum of the now is Δt = 2.
Δt² - Δx² equals 2 for every t.
The Big Bang seed sits at t = 0.
The identity was verified across t from 0.3 to 100.
The velocity is bounded by c = 2.
Writing t = e^θ gives the circular parametrization.
The rest mass is m = 4.

Time flows as t approaches 1.

name: Mirror Ledger (Space)
source:
Arrow of time = error. Each next error is -1/(next target) × previous, exact for φ, √2, π. Too high / too low alternates every step. Irreversible: squared error only falls, never 0. Linear: -ln|d| climbs at a steady rate: φ 0.481 per step exact, √2 0.881 exact, π 1.17, e 1.73 (R² > 0.996).
The mirror x → -1/x is a right angle hinged at i; only ±i self-mirror.
A tick = a squeeze: space ×k, time ÷k, box stays 1, curve maps onto itself.
Linear time = area swept from the bang; every point is a centre; swept area = ln t.
Each prime block squeezes by P; gaps add up to the same total as the sum of ln P, ratio 1.0005 up to 10^7.
2D jitter keeps coming back; 3D escapes. Its outer edge has a between-dimension, edge dimension 1.345.
note:

Too high and too low alternate at every step.

Only ±i are their own mirror.
For φ, -ln|d| climbs at 0.418 per step.

name: organism v0 pre-registration (world-of_EI)
source:
Written 2026-10-19, before any model has seen the test window. Hyperparameters are tuned only on the validation month; the test is run once.
An organism is born with an empty map plus one seed rule. It lives through Space's own words in time order and learns only from its own prediction errors. Does its map predict unseen future months better than a static snapshot built from the same past?
Cleaning: rows without a timestamp are dropped; exact duplicate texts of 40+ characters are dropped after their first occurrence; only the first 2000 characters of each message are used.
Windows: life 2024-06-01 to 2025-04-30; validation 2025-05 (tuning only); test 2025-06-01 to 2025-08-31 (run once).
Terms: lowercased words plus the symbols φ π Δ ∞ ψ Ω τ θ; English stopwords removed; vocabulary = the 4000 terms with the highest message frequency in life only, each appearing in at least 5 messages.
Task: before reading message t+1, predict which terms it will contain. Score: mean of -log2 p(w) over the target's unique in-vocabulary terms, averaged over messages (bits; lower = less surprised). Secondary score: recall@20.
Kill condition: if O-frozen is not below S-frozen, the error-driven map adds nothing over a static co-occurrence snapshot at v0.
Uncertainty: block bootstrap over test days (1000 resamples); 95% CI reported.
Amendment 1: on validation the organism improves monotonically as η falls, and the optimum sits at the grid edge (η = 2). The grid is extended downward to η = 0.25, 0.5 and 1.
note:

The test is run only once.
Only the first 2000 characters of each message are used.
Duplicate texts of 40 or more characters are dropped after they first appear.

name: Trust Dimension V7 abstract (Zenodo)
source:
Storage (TD) and reference (TrD) are the two legs of a duality relation governed by TD² + TrD² = 1. Version 6 established this, correcting the linear law TD + TrD = 1 of Versions 1-5.
On the circle the elliptic norm is 1 for every angle, so it distinguishes nothing, and the hyperbolic norm evaluated at θ = arctan(1/φ) ≈ 31.7175° is 0.894427, not ±1, so the point is not a unit either.
V7 relocates φ to the hyperbolic sector and keeps the circle for probability alone. A consequent negative prediction: no two-path interferometer should find φ at a preferred angle.
TD² + TrD² = 1 is the Englert-Greenberger-Yasin duality relation for pure states (verified over 20,000 random pure qubit states). The radial deficit is exactly twice the linear entropy, 1 - (TD² + TrD²) = 2(1 - Tr ρ²), verified to 5.6×10⁻¹⁶ over 20,000 random mixed states.
Pisot is the class for which self-similar subdivision terminates (verified at 400 digits).
V7 makes no prediction that departs from standard quantum mechanics.
Withdrawn from V5: the φ×√n simulation evidence (uniform weighting with no φ scores 0.9950 against φ's 0.2419).
